# its own Mac account (Abby, Borg Queen, the next one) a working teammate, as
# data. One list, read by both sides so they cannot drift (Jeff 2026-10-22

column3: Principal row has hostAccount: the Mac account it runs as
Principal row has holdsRole: the Role it holds
Principal row has agentRuntime: the runtime its pane starts
the Role row is typed chorus:AgentRole
the Role has both word-cap edges (response, nudge) to Property rows that exist
the Mac account is in group chorus, so it can write the repo
shared/agent_runtimes.json runsOn names it (until login reads agentRuntime from the door, #4694)
roles/<role>/AGENTS.md is generated from the claudemd manifest
the runtime is signed in, in its own pane (agy: Jeff's Google login)
